fusions.name: Bladed Heel
fusions.desc: Kicks with a blade set in your heel, dealing 4 damage to everything in a short arc 2 tiles ahead. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Miles in the Arm
fusions.desc: Throws a knife up to 8 tiles that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and hits up to 1.5 times harder at maximum range. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Footpad's Creep
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Waylayer
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%.
